profile.display_name: MikroTik Chateau LTE12 EG120K-EA RouterOS v7 lane
profile.notes: Observed Chateau LTE12 / D53G-5HacD2HnD with Quectel EG120K-EA on RouterOS v7. This lane is LTE-only but supports the MikroTik RouterOS + at-chat control surface: reliable CA-pool selection, native traffic counters, scheduler CQI/MCS/QAM reads, PLMN reads, restart, Wi-Fi toggle, and guarded QNWLOCK PCI cell lock. It must not fall back to the generic RouterOS family baseline once model, firmware, and RouterOS generation are known. CGF SMS is unavailable in this beta: full internal storage recovery is not verified. PBAND, band lock, and cell lock are best effort because RouterOS/modem firmware may ignore or revert them; their result is proven only by Matrix readback.
